name: Meridian Rail Systems
archetype: Technical B2B software with deep product documentation. Tests whether the generator uses precise operational detail, respects hard product limits, and attributes customer-measured numbers correctly.
summary: Scheduling and yard-management software for short-line and regional freight railroads in North America.

products.name: Meridian Dispatch
products.description: Scheduling engine producing a conflict-checked movement plan across a rolling 72-hour horizon.
capabilities: Conflict-checked movement planning over a 72-hour horizon
Treats manual dispatcher edits as hard constraints and re-plans around them
On-time interchange, crew utilisation and yard dwell reporting
Single-tenant hosted deployment in AWS us-east-2 or ca-central-1
limitations: No support for networks above 400 route miles
No positive train control integration, and none planned
Solver degrades above roughly 1,200 daily car movements
Canadian French localisation does not cover the reporting module

products.name: Meridian Yard
products.description: Classification and switching management for a single yard, including car placement and switch-list generation.
capabilities: Car placement tracking within a yard
Reconciliation against an existing car inventory system
limitations: Scoped to a single yard per licence

audiences.label: Short-line operations leadership
audiences.role: Director of Operations or General Manager at a short-line holding company
painPoints: Scheduling knowledge concentrated in one dispatcher approaching retirement
Interchange partners imposing new data requirements

audiences.label: Dispatchers and yardmasters
painPoints: Tools that discard manual edits on re-solve

differentiators: Manual dispatcher edits survive solver re-runs instead of being overwritten
Purpose-built for short-line and regional networks rather than Class I
Advisory-only by design, with no safety-critical scope
proofPoints: Cedar Ridge Terminal Railway: on-time interchange 71% to 88% over nine months
Cedar Ridge Terminal Railway: average yard dwell 14.2 to 11.6 hours
Plan rebuild after disruption reduced from roughly 40 minutes to under one minute at Cedar Ridge

brandVoice.sentenceStyle: Short declarative sentences, one idea each, quantified wherever a number exists.
